title: Area of the arena
prompt: The arena is width by height tiles, each tile 64 pixels. Return the arena's width in pixels times its height in pixels. arena_area(2, 3) is 24576.
starter:
func arena_area(width, height):
	return width * height
hints: Convert each side to pixels first.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.
